name: H3_2L_r0
reason: T3 scale separation (300 A cell), registry 0: two-level mesh: 30 A veins along the load every 100 A (level ratio 100/12 = 8, eight pore rows per domain), elongated fine pores
hypothesis: column class rule (veins 0.302 x 28.9 + fine 0.530 x 16.5) = 17.5 N/m; one-level trend of phase 1 at A = 0.53: 22.1 N/m (scatter 1.9).
